name: a guard on the stored stamp holds
a guard on a moved register is stale with its current stamp
a null guard on an unset register holds
a null guard on a set register is stale
a stamped guard on an unset register is stale with current null
a null guard on an absent record holds for its create
a guard on a register another record holds is checked too
a guard holds when the register already carries the stamp this intent writes (replay)
a command resolved as a replay skips its guards
a command that is not a replay checks its guards
